name: particle-dismiss
description: 关闭对话框、抽屉和提示时，元素化作粒子散去。 / Dissolve dialogs, drawers and toasts into particles as they close.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:types && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/index.js --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --legal-comments=none --banner:js='/*! particle-dismiss | Copyright 2026 zhaochen <453157936@qq.com> | Apache-2.0 */'
scripts.dev: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/index.js --format=esm --target=es2022 --watch --banner:js='/*! particle-dismiss | Copyright 2026 zhaochen <453157936@qq.com> | Apache-2.0 */'
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
